verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows Mistral models being offered through Bedrock, Vertex, Azure, or OpenRouter-class gateways. Regional inference is Mistral's own dedicated endpoints, and the open-weights self-hosting statement is a user-side deployment option, not managed availability through a third-party cloud or router.

support.subject: As a founder, I can consume the same models through major clouds or gateways — Bedrock, Vertex, Azure, or OpenRouter-class routers — not only the vendor's own endpoint
